name: pk-eli-mcp
description: Pakistani law with verifiable citations: full text of 967 federal statutes (a corpus collected from pakistancode.gov.pk, pinned to a fixed snapshot) and 1,414 Supreme Court of Pakistan judgments, plus a citation checker. Every answer carries its source and identifier, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Statute searches run on a local copy; judgment searches go to Hugging Face's public datasets service. Nothing goes to MateMatic.
